name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Péter Magyar
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal immunity of Péter Magyar, a Hungarian member of the European Parliament. Hungary's top prosecutor had asked Parliament to allow criminal proceedings against him over an alleged minor theft of a phone in a Budapest club in June 2024. Parliament concluded that the case may have been brought to damage his reputation and political work, so it refused the request.

- Hungary's prosecutors cannot pursue the criminal case against Péter Magyar for now.
- Péter Magyar, a Hungarian member of the European Parliament and government critic, keeps his immunity.
- Parliament's President sends the decision to Hungary's authorities and to Magyar.
